# miwale Game Style Library

> 33 complete visual styles for 2D games, each documented in enough detail that an AI can reproduce it: exact palette (hex), fonts, rendering technique, and the six design elements – world, characters, props, effects, atmosphere, UI – plus motion, do/don't rules, a step-by-step recipe and dependency-free starter code (Canvas 2D).

Use it when you have to give a project a distinct, coherent art style. Pick the style that fits the requested mood, read its STYLE.md completely and follow its rules; start from its starter.js. Elements of different styles can be combined – every element section of a STYLE.md stands on its own. All styles are free to copy and adapt.

Every style ships three files: `STYLE.md` (full spec, start here), `spec.json` (design tokens grouped by element), `starter.js` (standalone code with palette, core drawing helpers and a `draw(ctx, w, h, t)` preview). The visual reference of each style is the Canvas 2D module under `js/styles/<id>.js`.

## Styles

- [Harvest 16-Bit](https://miwale.com/styles/library/harvest16/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · SNES 16-bit. Cozy SNES-era autumn farmland: warm hue-shifted pixel sprites, leaf-litter carpets, furrowed fields and wooden HUD panels. Best for: top-down action games with many on-screen sprites, farming and life sims, cozy RPGs, Halloween / harvest themed projects, seasonal pixel-art scenes. Complexity 6/10.
- [Pumpkin Boy](https://miwale.com/styles/library/kuerbisboy/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · 4 Colours. A pumpkin-tinted handheld LCD: exactly four shades, Bayer dithering, crisp outlined mini sprites at 2 world units per pixel. Best for: crowded top-down arena games, top-down adventures and zelda-likes, farming or harvest games with a spooky twist, quick prototypes with a strict palette, monster-collecting RPGs. Complexity 4/10.
- [Gothic Night](https://miwale.com/styles/library/gothic/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · Dark. Moonlit cursed churchyard in detailed pixel art: a banded light map darkens a cold world; only faces, lanterns and candles glow warm. Best for: top-down action games, horror games, dungeon crawlers, Halloween-themed projects, stealth or light-radius scenes. Complexity 6/10.
- [Dusk Grove](https://miwale.com/styles/library/dusk/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · Modern HD-2D. Modern HD-2D pixel art: an enchanted forest clearing at golden-to-violet dusk, rim-lit sprites, banded glows, bloom and long shadows. Best for: top-down action games, cozy adventure RPGs, fairy-tale exploration games, farming/forest games with a day-night cycle, Halloween and harvest-festival projects. Complexity 7/10.
- [Bouncy Cartoon](https://miwale.com/styles/library/cartoon/STYLE.md): Vector · Cartoon. Candy-bright HD vector cartoon: thick deep-plum outlines, one cel-shade crescent, one white gloss and bouncy squash & stretch. Best for: top-down arena shooters, crowded top-down action with hundreds of on-screen characters, casual mobile action, party and co-op games, kid-friendly adventures. Complexity 3/10.
- [Paper World](https://miwale.com/styles/library/paper/STYLE.md): Papercraft · Cut-paper diorama. A handmade craft-table diorama: stop-motion paper puppets with cream sticker rims and brass split pins on layered kraft, felt and newsprint. Best for: top-down action games, cozy adventure and farming games, puzzle and board-game adaptations, kids' and family games, seasonal or holiday themes. Complexity 6/10.
- [Watercolor Storybook](https://miwale.com/styles/library/watercolor/STYLE.md): Illustrated · Watercolor. Transparent watercolour washes and loose, broken ink lines on warm cold-pressed paper: a living illustrated fairy-tale book. Best for: fairy-tale top-down action games, cozy adventure and farming games, story-driven RPGs and visual-novel maps, board-game or storybook map screens. Complexity 8/10.
- [Neon Midnight](https://miwale.com/styles/library/neon/STYLE.md): Vector · Neon. Glowing neon tube line-art with baked halos on a calm near-black floor of glowing roads, pattern districts and water. Best for: arcade shooters, twin-stick and bullet-hell games, rhythm and music games, retro-futuristic puzzle games, top-down arena action with crowded screens. Complexity 3/10.
- [Low-Poly Diorama](https://miwale.com/styles/library/lowpoly/STYLE.md): 3D Look · Low Poly. A toy-like autumn miniature world of flat-shaded triangle facets in soft afternoon light, with tilt-shift blur at the screen edges. Best for: top-down action games with crowds of units, cozy farming or village sims, tactics and strategy maps, casual puzzle-adventure, idle / builder games. Complexity 5/10.
- [Linocut](https://miwale.com/styles/library/linocut/STYLE.md): Printmaking · Linocut. A moving linocut print: cream paper, carbon-black key plate, one misregistered pumpkin-orange spot plate and a sparing teal. Best for: top-down action games, folk-horror and fairy-tale games, card and board games, narrative / visual-novel art, puzzle games with strong silhouettes. Complexity 6/10.
- [8-Bit Arcade](https://miwale.com/styles/library/nes8bit/STYLE.md): Pixel Art · NES 8-bit. A late NES cartridge: strict 2C02 palette, black-outlined sprites posed from parts, 8-frame walks and tile-language meadows. Best for: top-down action games, arcade shooters, retro platformers and Zelda-like adventures, quick prototypes with strict rules, chiptune rhythm or score-attack games. Complexity 4/10.
- [Cathedral Glass](https://miwale.com/styles/library/stainedglass/STYLE.md): Mosaic · Stained Glass. A living cathedral window: jewel-tone glass pieces in dark lead came, lit from behind by warm light and coloured rays. Best for: top-down action games with many figures on screen, fairy-tale action RPGs, puzzle and match games, holiday or harvest-themed arcade games, card and board game UIs. Complexity 7/10.
- [Clay World](https://miwale.com/styles/library/clay/STYLE.md): Claymation · Stop-motion plasticine. Stop-motion plasticine miniature set: soft gradient-built clay figures with fingerprints, warm studio light and 12 fps boil. Best for: top-down action and arena games, cozy adventures and farming games, puzzle and party games, family-friendly platformers seen from above, casual mobile games. Complexity 5/10.
- [Chalkboard](https://miwale.com/styles/library/chalk/STYLE.md): Traditional media · Chalk. Drawn live with pastel chalk on a slate-green board: side-of-the-chalk fills, cool hatched shadows, eraser wipes and line boil on twos. Best for: top-down action games, kids and educational games, cozy seasonal games, puzzle and board-game adaptations, sketchbook-themed platformers. Complexity 6/10.
- [Trick or Treat](https://miwale.com/styles/library/candy/STYLE.md): Rendered Cartoon · Candy Gloss. A glossy Halloween candy world: hard-candy shine, gummy jelly, matte marshmallow and chocolate on a melting chocolate floor. Best for: cute top-down action games with many figures, casual arcade games, match/puzzle games with characters, holiday events, kids-friendly action. Complexity 6/10.
- [Cross-Stitch Sampler](https://miwale.com/styles/library/crossstitch/STYLE.md): Textile · Cross-stitch embroidery. The whole world is a living cross-stitch sampler on Aida cloth: every cell is a real thread X, contours are backstitched. Best for: top-down arena or action games, cozy farming or adventure games, puzzle and board-like games on a grid, seasonal or holiday projects, games with crowds of small readable sprites. Complexity 3/10.
- [Pop-Art Comic](https://miwale.com/styles/library/popart/STYLE.md): Comic · Pop-Art print. A printed 1960s comic book come alive: brush-ink outlines, flat process colours, Ben-Day dots and slipped colour plates. Best for: top-down arena action with crowds of figures, beat-'em-ups and brawlers, superhero or Halloween party games, B-movie and pulp-comic themes, card and shop screens with strong UI. Complexity 5/10.
- [Starry Night](https://miwale.com/styles/library/vangogh/STYLE.md): Traditional media · Impasto oil painting. A living Van Gogh night painting: thick, directional impasto strokes in ultramarine, viridian and cadmium yellow that follow every form. Best for: atmospheric night adventure games, top-down action games with a free camera, art-themed or museum games, cozy night exploration, short arthouse games. Complexity 8/10.
- [Shadow Theatre](https://miwale.com/styles/library/shadow/STYLE.md): Silhouette · Paper Shadow Puppets. Backlit paper shadow-puppet theatre: indigo-black cut-paper silhouettes over glowing teal, violet, crimson and amber light fields. Best for: top-down action games with crowded scenes, halloween or folklore projects, puzzle-platformers with silhouette art, storybook adventures, rhythm games with a stage theme. Complexity 4/10.
- [Voxel Cube World](https://miwale.com/styles/library/voxel/STYLE.md): 3D Look · Voxel. A bright MagicaVoxel-style miniature world: every object is a real 3D cube grid, baked to sprites under one warm afternoon sun. Best for: top-down arena and action games, farming and village sims, tactics games, builder and puzzle games, casual mobile games. Complexity 3/10.
- [Blueprint](https://miwale.com/styles/library/blueprint/STYLE.md): Line art · Technical drawing. A living technical drawing: white line work, dimension lines and hatching on deep cyan-blue drafting paper with a fine grid. Best for: engineering and building games, puzzle and logic games, factory and automation sims, tower defense with machines, top-down arena action with crowded screens. Complexity 4/10.
- [Ukiyo-e Woodblock](https://miwale.com/styles/library/ukiyoe/STYLE.md): Print · Woodblock. An Edo-period colour woodblock print in motion: bokashi colour blocks printed off-register, carved sumi key lines, washi fibres, seigaiha water. Best for: top-down action and adventure games with a folklore theme, calm exploration and travel games, Japanese-inspired fantasy RPGs and card games, story maps, menus and festival-themed projects. Complexity 7/10.
- [Thermal Vision](https://miwale.com/styles/library/thermal/STYLE.md): Infrared · False colour. The world through an infrared camera: every surface is a temperature mapped through an ironbow ramp; warm bodies glow white-hot. Best for: stealth and infiltration games, night-time hunting or rescue games, sci-fi and military top-down shooters, horror games about unseen creatures, detective or drone-camera puzzle games. Complexity 4/10.
- [Terminal ASCII](https://miwale.com/styles/library/terminal/STYLE.md): Text Mode · CRT Phosphor. The world drawn entirely in text glyphs on a green phosphor CRT: one fixed character grid, glowing multi-glyph figures, scanlines. Best for: grid-based dungeon crawlers, hacker and cyber themed projects, minimalist action or puzzle games, rapid prototypes with no art budget, retro computing tributes. Complexity 3/10.
- [Origami Fold](https://miwale.com/styles/library/origami/STYLE.md): Paper · Origami. A world folded from washi paper: flat-lit facets, mountain and valley creases, hemmed pastel sheets and stop-motion paper puppets. Best for: cozy top-down action and adventure, puzzle games and board-game adaptations, children's and educational games, zen, relaxing or seasonal projects, papercraft-themed menus and map screens. Complexity 6/10.
- [Rubber Hose 1930s](https://miwale.com/styles/library/rubberhose/STYLE.md): Cartoon · Vintage animation. Black-and-white 1930s animation: ink figures with elbow-less rubber-hose limbs, white gloves and pie-cut eyes, projected through grainy, scratched film. Best for: retro top-down action with crowds of characters, vintage cartoon platformers and brawlers, music or rhythm projects, spooky-cute or carnival themes, nostalgic menus, title screens and trailers. Complexity 4/10.
- [Vaporwave Sunset](https://miwale.com/styles/library/vaporwave/STYLE.md): Vector · Vaporwave. Pastel vaporwave plazas of pink marble, checkerboards and tiled pools under a sunset wash, with VHS fringes on every sprite. Best for: retro-themed arcade and arena games, chill exploration or collecting games, music, lo-fi and synthwave-adjacent projects, menus, title screens and promo art with a 90s internet flavour, satirical or meme-flavoured games. Complexity 4/10.
- [Sumi-e Ink](https://miwale.com/styles/library/sumie/STYLE.md): Painterly · Ink wash. Monochrome ink-wash painting in motion: black sumi in five tones on warm xuan paper, one-stroke brushwork, lots of empty space, one vermilion accent. Best for: calm exploration and travel games with an East-Asian theme, martial-arts and folklore action games that want a painterly look, zen, meditation and puzzle projects, story maps, title screens and scroll-based menus. Complexity 6/10.
- [Toy Bricks](https://miwale.com/styles/library/bricks/STYLE.md): 3D Look · Toy Bricks. A toy-box world of glossy plastic bricks: stud-covered baseplates, tiled roads, transparent-blue water plates and a little toy figure. Best for: family and kids games, top-down action and arena games, builder and sandbox games, puzzle and party games, casual mobile games. Complexity 4/10.
- [Risograph Print](https://miwale.com/styles/library/riso/STYLE.md): Print · Risograph. A three-ink risograph zine: fluorescent pink, blue and yellow overprinting on recycled paper, out of register, with halftones and drum grain. Best for: colourful top-down action and arcade games, indie games with a zine or poster identity, music, festival and art-scene projects, cheerful puzzle and party games, menus, title cards and promo art. Complexity 5/10.
- [Crayon Kids](https://miwale.com/styles/library/crayon/STYLE.md): Hand-drawn · Wax crayon. A child's wax-crayon drawing brought to life: toothy paper, layered scribble fills that miss the lines, shade crayons, boiling outlines. Best for: children's and family games, cozy or comedic top-down action, educational and storybook projects, doodle-themed menus, tutorials and level select screens, party and casual mobile games. Complexity 5/10.
- [Deep Sea Glow](https://miwale.com/styles/library/deepsea/STYLE.md): Underwater · Bioluminescent. The abyssal sea floor at night, lit only by living light: glowing jellies, kelp and coral, marine snow and blue depth fog. Best for: underwater exploration games, calm atmospheric adventures, horror games about light and darkness, night or deep-space style worlds with glowing life, relaxing collect-and-explore games. Complexity 5/10.
- [Art Deco Gold](https://miwale.com/styles/library/artdeco/STYLE.md): Vector · Art Deco. A 1920s grand lobby: onyx, emerald and midnight marble inlaid with metallic gold sunbursts, chevrons, fans and stepped corners. Best for: stylish top-down action and arcade projects, heist, casino, hotel or jazz-age settings, luxury puzzle and match games, elegant menus, title screens and card UIs, art-deco inspired city builders and museums. Complexity 5/10.

## Machine-readable

- [Catalog (JSON)](https://miwale.com/styles/styles.json): every style with tags, palette, fonts, complexity and file links
- [All specs in one file](https://miwale.com/styles/llms-full.txt): every STYLE.md concatenated
- [Authoring format](https://miwale.com/styles/library/AUTHORING.md): schema of spec.json, STYLE.md and starter.js, and the design elements
